rows.label: qst650513_msg0001
rows.name:
It would appear we are here.
This is the Holy War Wall
which we were to investigate.

rows.label: qst650513_msg0002
rows.name:
The land seems ravaged. It's
like some ancient battleground.

rows.label: qst650513_msg0003
rows.name: That is exactly what it is.

rows.label: qst650513_msg0004
rows.name:
And there was another major
battle here just recently.

rows.label: qst650513_msg0005
rows.name:
Indeed... Regrettably, one of the
parties responsible for that was my
homeland, the Superbian Empire.

rows.label: qst650513_msg0006
rows.name:
From your tone...
you opposed that war.

rows.label: qst650513_msg0007
rows.name:
Completely. Of course, in
certain matters conflict
is simply unavoidable...

rows.label: qst650513_msg0008
rows.name: But this was not one of those matters.

rows.label: qst650513_msg0009
rows.name:
A foolish war, born from piling one
folly on another and being manipulated
by those who sought to exploit it.

rows.label: qst650513_msg0011
rows.name: Every world is the same, it seems.

rows.label: qst650513_msg0012
rows.name: Was it like that on Mira, too?

rows.label: qst650513_msg0013
rows.name:
The struggle for survival on Mira
was still a purer kind of conflict.

rows.label: qst650513_msg0014
rows.name:
I mean the rise and fall of
interstellar civilizations
I witnessed long ago...

rows.label: qst650513_msg0015
rows.name:
And the clash of two great powers near
Earth... That was a truly foolish war.

rows.label: qst650513_msg0016
rows.name:
I can't fully understand everything
you're saying, but I can feel
the deep sadness behind it.

rows.label: qst650513_msg0017
rows.name:
At least where I can see and act,
I want to stop pointless wars.
